parameters.query:
INSERT INTO contacts (whatsapp_id, phone, display_name, last_contact_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, NULLIF($3, ''), NOW())
ON CONFLICT (whatsapp_id) DO UPDATE SET
  phone = EXCLUDED.phone,
  display_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.display_name, contacts.display_name),
  last_contact_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, state;

WITH contact_row AS (
  SELECT id, state FROM contacts WHERE whatsapp_id = $2
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO message_events (external_id, contact_id, direction, message_type, content_summary, media_reference, event_at)
  SELECT $1, id, 'incoming', $3, NULLIF($4, ''), NULLIF($5, ''), $6::timestamptz FROM contact_row
  ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
), config AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'evolution_instance'), 'kit-matematica') AS "evolutionInstance",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'product_price'), '9.90') AS "productPrice",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'pix_key'), '') AS "pixKey",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'pix_key_type'), 'telefone') AS "pixKeyType",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'pix_receiver_name'), '') AS "pixReceiverName",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'materials_drive_url'), '') AS "materialsDriveUrl",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'followup_minutes'), '15,60,91') AS "followupMinutes",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'payment_notify_phone'), '') AS "paymentNotifyPhone",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_access_token'), '') AS "mercadoPagoAccessToken",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_min_amount'), '10.00') AS "mercadoPagoMinAmount"
  FROM app_config
)
SELECT c.id AS "contactId", c.state, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS inserted,
       $2::text AS "whatsappId", $7::text AS phone, $8::text AS intent,
       $3::text AS "messageType", $4::text AS text, $5::text AS "mediaReference",
       config."evolutionInstance", config."productPrice", config."pixKey", config."pixKeyType",
       config."pixReceiverName", config."materialsDriveUrl", config."followupMinutes", config."paymentNotifyPhone",
       config."mercadoPagoAccessToken", config."mercadoPagoMinAmount"
FROM contact_row c CROSS JOIN config;

parameters.query:
WITH sale AS (
  INSERT INTO sales (contact_id, expected_amount) VALUES ($1, $2::numeric)
  ON CONFLICT (contact_id) WHERE status = 'pending' DO UPDATE SET expected_amount = EXCLUDED.expected_amount
  RETURNING id, contact_id, expected_amount
), schedule AS (
  SELECT string_to_array($3, ',')::int[] AS mins
), created AS (
  INSERT INTO followups (contact_id, sale_id, sequence_number, scheduled_at)
  SELECT sale.contact_id, sale.id, ordinality::smallint, NOW() + (minute_value || ' minutes')::interval
  FROM sale, schedule, unnest(schedule.mins) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(minute_value, ordinality)
  ON CONFLICT (contact_id, sequence_number) DO NOTHING
), contact_update AS (
  UPDATE contacts SET state = 'awaiting_payment', next_followup_at = NOW() + (split_part($3, ',', 1) || ' minutes')::interval
  WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id
), config AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_access_token'), '') AS "mercadoPagoAccessToken",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_min_amount'), '10.00') AS "mercadoPagoMinAmount"
  FROM app_config
)
SELECT sale.id AS "saleId", sale.contact_id AS "contactId", sale.expected_amount AS "expectedAmount",
       config."mercadoPagoAccessToken", config."mercadoPagoMinAmount"
FROM sale CROSS JOIN config;

UPDATE sales
SET mercado_pago_payment_id = $2,
    mercado_pago_status = $3,
    mercado_pago_status_detail = $4,
    mercado_pago_external_reference = $5,
    mercado_pago_qr_code = $6,

RETURNING id AS "saleId", mercado_pago_payment_id AS "mercadoPagoPaymentId", mercado_pago_qr_code AS "mercadoPagoQrCode", mercado_pago_qr_code_base64 AS "mercadoPagoQrCodeBase64";
